column2: First, in the north of the continent lies the Grosain Empire, the mightiest power in Arcaya.{wait}{clear}Its capital is Reizefut, in the Reizefut region. It covers about a third of the continent, and a third of its land is frozen tundra.{wait}{clear}It is a land with a very long history, said to have once been a great empire ruling nearly the whole continent.{wait}{clear}Even now it is a military nation with superbly disciplined knightly orders.{wait}{clear}

East of the Grosain Empire lie the Duchy of Courrege and the Duchy of Zern.{wait}{clear}The land there is very harsh, so few people live there. One could call it the frontier of the continent.{wait}{clear}Perhaps because of the land, many superstitions are still told there.{wait}{clear}However, I could not look closely into the lands north of Courrege. It seems to be a greatly feared place.{wait}{clear}

South of the Empire lies the Holy Nation of Ecclesia. It is a state united by its faith, and its capital is Araras, in Linares.{wait}{clear}It has been ruled by a line of popes, and the enormous cathedral in its capital draws the faith of many people.{wait}{clear}In the Selva region lies Lake Dreihaup, the largest lake on the Yerasel continent.{wait}{clear}

Southwest of the Empire and west of the Holy Nation lies the Six Kingdoms Alliance, made up of six countries.{wait}{clear}Its six kingdoms, Labirk, Celesta, Lanas, Lefkas, Frezelecia and Basel, thrive on trade and are very wealthy.{wait}{clear}Its central city is Alkmaar, in Basel. And ships leave from Suore, in Labirk, for the island in the west.{wait}{clear}

Floating in the Athlone Sea to the west is Bremes Island, the largest island in Arcaya.{wait}{clear}People are said to have settled it a few hundred years ago, so it seems to be a young land.{wait}{clear}But a mountain range runs across it from east to west, so flat land is scarce and it is not a very blessed place.{wait}{clear}The Kavakia peninsula, southwest of the continent, is untamed land, and the forest covering most of it is called the Reyforia Forest.{wait}{clear}Hardly anyone from the continent goes there, but tribes have always lived in that forest.{wait}{clear}They have their own culture and way of life, and many of their legends and myths are handed down.{wait}{clear}

At the southern tip of the continent lies the Kingdom of Legrance. Its capital is Fanlan, in Ellora.{wait}{clear}It seems it was once split into an eastern and a western kingdom, but about fifty years ago the two royal houses joined to form today's Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}Because it was united so recently, and because the old kingdoms differed, it seems to have various problems.{wait}{clear}
